now: Peggy wakes in the present and learns the Hydra Stomper is Steve, kept by the Red Room.
proposed: Peggy and Natasha find Steve inside the Hydra Stomper, brainwashed by the Red Room, and he gives his life to destroy it.
their_evidence: Peggy does not wake in #14: she came out of the Tesseract portal into the present back in #1 and is already on a S.H.I.E.L.D. mission. In #14 she and Natasha find Steve inside the Hydra Stomper aboard the Lemurian Star; the Red Room captured and brainwashed him, and he sacrifices himself to destroy the Red Room.

e: Peggy Carter takes the super soldier serum, and Steve Rogers fights beside her in a suit of armor.
Peggy wakes in the present and learns the Hydra Stomper is Steve, kept by the Red Room.

now: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain the Celestial buried in Earth, and Kingo talks her out of it.
proposed: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain Tiamut, the Celestial buried in Earth. She takes its power to defeat Arishem, then Kingo talks her into giving it up.
their_evidence: Kingo does not talk her out of the plan: with Stark and Jarvis's help Agatha takes Kingo's and Tiamut's powers and becomes a Celestial; after defeating Arishem, Kingo convinces her to give up the Celestial power and join him in the movie business.

e: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain the Celestial buried in Earth, and Kingo talks her out of it.

now: Ultron gives up on destroying his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.
proposed: Ultron, regretting that he wiped out all life in his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.
their_evidence: In #25 this Ultron has already destroyed all life in his universe, eons earlier; he says he realized there is no peace without life and that extinguishing it was a mistake, then agrees to help rescue Carter and the Watcher. In #26 he sacrifices himself to buy them time. He doesn't give up on destroying his universe, because he already did it.

e: Ultron takes all six Infinity Stones and wipes out life across his universe.
Ultron gives up on destroying his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.

now: Kamala, Kate, Yelena and Riri fight their way across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead.
proposed: Kamala, Kate and Riri set out across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead, and only Kamala lives to reach Yelena's group in Ohio.
their_evidence: Kamala travels with Kate, Riri and F.R.I.D.A.Y., not Yelena. Kate is killed by zombie Carol Danvers and Riri sacrifices herself on the way; Blade Knight brings Kamala to the North Institute in Ohio, where she meets Melina, Alexei and Yelena. The four named never travel together.

e: A plague spreads from the Quantum Realm and turns the Avengers into the walking dead.
Kamala, Kate, Yelena and Riri fight their way across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead.
Zemo and John Walker run the drifting Raft as a haven for survivors, until zombie Namor breaks in and kills Walker.
Blade Knight wins the survivors entry to New Asgard by revealing Khonshu, and they escape aboard an Asgardian ship as Thor holds off Wanda.
In the final battle in Paris, Wanda's army swarms the Infinity Hulk, and a zombified Thor kills Blade Knight.

now: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis flee across the galaxy, from Las Vegas to Knowhere and Jotunheim, to protect their unhatched egg.
proposed: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis chase their stolen egg across the galaxy, from the Grandmaster's cruise to Knowhere and Jotunheim, as every power in the Nine Realms tries to claim it.
their_evidence: They don't start in Las Vegas (the Las Vegas party is #7). In #22 they join the Grandmaster's cruise, Yondu steals the egg, and they pursue it to Knowhere, where Kaecilius has it. They then take it to Loki on Jotunheim, where Laufey, Zeus, Malekith and Thanos's Black Order all go after it.

e: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis flee across the galaxy, from Las Vegas to Knowhere and Jotunheim, to protect their unhatched egg.
At Thor's wild party in Las Vegas, Howard the Duck asks Darcy Lewis out, and the two are soon engaged.

proposed: The Watcher takes Peggy from a mission aboard the Lemurian Star into the Guardians of the Multiverse. Back home, she and Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor with someone inside.
their_evidence: The Watcher recruits Captain Carter while she infiltrates Batroc's ship, the Lemurian Star, in her universe. After Ultron's defeat she is sent home, and in the mid-credits scene she and her universe's Black Widow find the Hydra Stomper armor on Batroc's ship. This also covers the lead A:by-natasha-carter:0 (#9) to carter.

e: Peggy Carter takes the super soldier serum, and Steve Rogers fights beside her in a suit of armor.
Peggy wakes in the present and learns the Hydra Stomper is Steve, kept by the Red Room.

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi| (the Sanctum Infinitum and the Forge), What If...?#18. The line's Carter's-world part (freeing Steve from the Red Room) is #14 and its 1602 part is #17, and both already have entries at carter and y1602. The #18 tag doesn't fit those places.

their_evidence: In #18 Strange Supreme takes Carter to the Sanctum Infinitum, where she and Kahhori bring down the Forge. The Watcher then takes her to Strange's restored universe. The Red Room arc is #14 and the 1602 incursion is #17.

e: Peggy Carter takes the super soldier serum, and Steve Rogers fights beside her in a suit of armor.
Peggy wakes in the present and learns the Hydra Stomper is Steve, kept by the Red Room.

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi|, What If...?#18. Carter stops the 1602 incursion in #17, which already has an entry here.

their_evidence: Carter stops the incursion and is met by Strange Supreme at the end of #17. Everything in #18 happens at Strange Supreme's Sanctum Infinitum and in his restored universe.

e: Captain Carter is pulled into 1602 England, where King Thor rules and an outlaw named Rogers Hood turns out to be Steve Rogers, lost in time.

proposed: Strange Supreme helps the Watcher gather the Guardians of the Multiverse. Afterwards he keeps watch over Killmonger and Zola, sealed in a pocket dimension, in his own ruined universe.
their_evidence: The Watcher (who fled to Strange Supreme's universe at the end of #8) recruits the team with Strange. After the fight, Strange encapsulates Zola and Killmonger in a pocket dimension, the Watcher teleports him back home, and Strange assigns himself to watch the bubble. This covers leads A:by-guardians-multiverse:1, T:by-killmonger:2, T:by-arnim-zola:1 and T:by-strange-supreme:1 (all #9 to strange).

e: Doctor Strange tears his universe apart trying to save Christine.
Strange Supreme feeds captured heroes and villains into the Forge, trying to rebuild his universe and Christine.

proposed: Now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence, the Incarnate and the Executioner of their power.
their_evidence: Carter carries her team to Strange Supreme's universe, where Strange, now the universe's sentient consciousness, removes the three Watchers' powers. The file T:by-strange-supreme:4 points here, but the place has no S3 entry.

e: Doctor Strange tears his universe apart trying to save Christine.
Strange Supreme feeds captured heroes and villains into the Forge, trying to rebuild his universe and Christine.

proposed: Now Nova Prime, Nebula leads the Nova Corps against a monster attacking Xandar, and Captain Carter's Guardians help her bring it down.
their_evidence: A cosmic squid monster attacks Xandar while Nova Prime Nebula coordinates the Nova Corps. Captain Carter, Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm arrive and help defeat it, and Nebula thanks them for saving her world.

e: Nebula, now in the Nova Corps, investigates Yondu's murder on a Xandar sealed behind its planetary shield.

proposed: The Watcher takes Gamora into the Guardians of the Multiverse as she and Tony melt down the Infinity Gauntlet with Eitri, and later returns her to him.
their_evidence: In #9 the Watcher abducts this universe's Gamora as she melts the Infinity Gauntlet with Iron Man and Eitri. At the end she reunites with Iron Man. (The ep tag for this line is #9; if the file line actually describes the Sakaar race, that is #13 and already has an entry here.)

e: Tony is pulled through a wormhole to Sakaar and races the Grandmaster's grand prix with Valkyrie and Korg.

proposed: The Watcher pulls Killmonger out of Wakanda just as Pepper, Shuri and the Dora Milaje close in, taking him into the Guardians of the Multiverse.
their_evidence: The Watcher abducts Erik Killmonger in Wakanda, just as Pepper Potts, Shuri and the Dora Milaje close in on him. (The killmonger place is not in this batch.)

e: Killmonger saves Tony Stark from a Ten Rings ambush, builds vibranium drones with him, then kills T'Challa and Rhodey in a staged fight.

proposed: The Watcher brings Natasha from Ultron's ruined world here, and she steals Loki's scepter and subdues him with it.
their_evidence: Unable to restore Black Widow's world, the Watcher places her in the universe where the Avengers were assassinated, as Fury, Captain Marvel and Captain America fight Loki. She steals the Scepter and uses it to subdue him. (The pymworld place is not in this batch.)

e: Grieving his daughter Hope, Hank Pym shrinks down and kills Fury's Avengers candidates one by one, until Fury and Loki expose him.

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi| (Strange Supreme's Sanctum Infinitum), What If...?#18. The line's Kahhori's-world part (Tesseract power, the conquistadors) is #15, which already has an entry here.

their_evidence: In #18 Kahhori helps Carter bring down Strange Supreme's Forge at the Sanctum Infinitum. Only afterwards does the Watcher return her home. She gains her power and drives out the conquistadors in #15.

e: Kahhori, a Mohawk woman, falls into a lake the Tesseract has changed, gains its power in the Sky World and drives off the Spanish conquistadors.

question: The S3 Ultron is a different variant: per #25 Carter seeks out one of the many Ultrons who never heard the Watcher, who wiped out life in his own universe. Should his entry stay at 'Ultron's world' (the #8 reality, whose Ultron left for the multiverse and was sealed away in #9)?
options: Keep it here (same kind of world)
Move it to a separate 'another Ultron's world' place
Drop the place mention and keep it only on the file
their_evidence: Fandom calls him 'Reflective Infinity Ultron', a separate variant; Storm notes there are many Ultron variants who never got to hear the Watcher, and Carter goes to the universe where that Ultron destroyed all life.

e: Ultron takes all six Infinity Stones and wipes out life across his universe.
Ultron gives up on destroying his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.

question: Nebula's Xandar is called Earth-625 in What If...? #25. Should the region line give that number instead of 'Another reality'?
their_evidence: Wikipedia's #25 summary: the team stops a universe-eater 'from attacking Earth-625', which a footnote identifies as the universe of 'What If... Nebula Joined the Nova Corps?'. The MCU fandom files Nebula under 'Nebula/Earth-625'.

e: Nebula, now in the Nova Corps, investigates Yondu's murder on a Xandar sealed behind its planetary shield.

their_evidence: The Marvel Database gives the Spider-Noir series (Ben Reilly, 1930s New York) the reality Earth-62533 (Spider-Noir series page and every episode page link Earth-62533). No Earth-TRN1832 page exists on the Marvel Database (TRN1831 and TRN1833 do), so the number is invented.

e: Ben Reilly, a private eye who was once the Spider, is pulled back in by Silvermane and Dr. Faber.

now: Peter Parker gets his powers and an internship at Oscorp under Norman Osborn.
proposed: Peter Parker starts an internship at Oscorp, where Norman Osborn shows him footage proving he knows Peter is Spider-Man.
their_evidence: Peter is bitten and gets his powers in episode 1 ("Amazing Fantasy"). In episode 2 ("The Parker Luck") Norman offers and Peter accepts the Oscorp internship, and at the end Norman shows Peter security footage of him putting on his suit.

e: Peter Parker gets his powers and an internship at Oscorp under Norman Osborn.

now: Peter Parker swings through New York, stopping the Vulture and the Green Goblin.
proposed: Spider-Man sends a metal-eating robot into the river, then stops the Green Goblin from calling up demons with a stolen book of witchcraft.
their_evidence: Episode 6 is "Diet of Destruction" (a metal-eating robot from Central Park, which Spider-Man drops into the river) and "The Witching Hour" (the Green Goblin steals Grandini's witchcraft book to summon demons). The Vulture is not in it; his stories are episodes 4a and 16a.

e: Peter Parker swings through New York, stopping the Vulture and the Green Goblin.
In Florida, Spider-Man learns of Dr. Connors's swamp fever research, fights the Lizard in a ruined Spanish fort, and turns him back into Connors.
In Florida, Spider-Man finds Dr. Connors held prisoner in the old Spanish fort, where a conquistador guards a Fountain of Youth.
An alligator made intelligent by Dr. Connors's experiments kidnaps him to rule the swamps, until Spider-Man turns the serum against it.
Dr. Noah Boddy breaks the Green Goblin, Electro and the Vulture out of prison, and Spider-Man tricks them into fighting each other at the docks.
A Spider-Man from 2099, Miguel O'Hara, drops into this universe and ends up in a finger-pointing argument with its Spider-Man.
Bitten by a radioactive spider, Peter fails to stop the thief who kills Uncle Ben, then takes a job at the Daily Bugle.
The Master Technician lifts Manhattan into the sky for ransom, until Spider-Man beats him and he is jailed.
Captain Ned Stacy rescues the injured Spider-Man, who then saves him from a prison breakout.
The Kingpin runs a brainwashing scheme from a Times Square nightclub, until Spider-Man foils it.
Calling himself the Radiation Specialist, the Master Technician lifts Manhattan again, and Spider-Man beats him with Captain Stacy's help.

now: Bitten by a radioactive spider, Peter fails to stop the thief who kills Uncle Ben, then takes a job at the Daily Bugle.

Episode 22, "King Pinned", opens with Ben already dead: Peter gets the Bugle job for May's medicine, uncovers the Kingpin's drug counterfeiting ring, rescues the kidnapped Jameson and saves the Bugle from a time bomb.
